subject.title: fix(xai): apply request policy to video generation requests

question: Should configured xAI provider headers apply to generated-video downloads, and if so, which download origins are trusted to receive Authorization and custom headers?
rationale: Automation cannot safely choose between incomplete header support and forwarding sensitive provider headers to an arbitrary URL returned by the service.

options.title: Origin-aware headers
options.body: Forward configured headers only to trusted xAI origins while applying proxy and private-network controls to every generated-media request.

options.title: Transport-only downloads
options.body: Intentionally exclude provider headers from generated-media downloads and align the PR description and tests with that narrower contract.

options.title: Pause for contract proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until xAI's generated-media origin contract is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Origin-aware headers
recommendation.body: Forward configured headers only to trusted xAI origins while applying proxy and private-network controls to every generated-media request.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the affected provider and is the strongest available owner for its download credential boundary.
